text: The Public Utilities Board (PUB) was appointed as Singapore's National Coastal Protection Agency in April 2020. This appointment consolidated the responsibility for defending Singapore's 300 km low-lying coastline against sea-level rise and compound flood risks under a single statutory board. PUB's multi-pronged program includes policy and legislation, standard-setting, advanced modeling, site-specific planning, and a research-and-innovation portfolio. The initiative aims to implement coastal defenses in a timely and flexible manner, integrating hybrid nature-based and hard-infrastructure measures.
